gse_ml_service_5_models.name: Topological Data Analysis (TDA) — Vietoris-Rips Persistent Homology & Persistence Images
gse_ml_service_5_models.mathematical_formulation: H_0 MST connected-component merges + H_1 1-cycle loop births/deaths on 22-player Next Gen / tracking coordinates, mapped to birth-persistence (b, p=d-b) Gaussian integral grid I(P) via exact erf differences.

gse_ml_service_5_models.name: Matrix Product State (MPS / Tensor-Train) Factorized Linear Layer
gse_ml_service_5_models.mathematical_formulation: Matrix Product Operator (MPO) decomposition of weight matrix W in R^{M x N} into k=4 cores G_m in R^{r_{m-1} x m_m x n_m x r_m} contracted sequentially via torch.einsum('bMrnt,rmns->bMmst') with bond dimension chi=8.
gse_ml_service_5_models.hardware_tier: Tier A/B (Local PyTorch CPU + Intel Iris Xe DirectML)

gse_ml_service_5_models.name: Maximum-Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning (Ziebart 2008 MaxEnt IRL)
gse_ml_service_5_models.mathematical_formulation: Recovers latent coaching reward weights theta from observed drive trajectories via soft Bellman value iteration V(s) = log sum_a exp(r_theta(s) + gamma sum_{s'} T(s,a,s') V(s')) and gradient grad_theta L = mu_empirical - E_theta[mu].
gse_ml_service_5_models.hardware_tier: Tier A (Local Vectorized Soft-Bellman Dynamic Programming)

gse_ml_service_5_models.name: Friston Variational Free Energy — Two-Level Hierarchical Predictive Coder
gse_ml_service_5_models.mathematical_formulation: Minimizes variational free energy F(x) = E_q[-log p(x|z_1)] + KL(q(z_1|x,z_2) || p(z_1|z_2)) + KL(q(z_2|x) || N(0,I)) with precision-weighted prediction errors epsilon_1, epsilon_2 and surprise Score = -log p(x).
gse_ml_service_5_models.hardware_tier: Tier A/B (Local PyTorch CPU + Intel Iris Xe DirectML)

gse_ml_service_5_models.name: Square-Root Ensemble Transform Kalman Filter (Bishop 2001 / Wang 2004 ETKF)
gse_ml_service_5_models.mathematical_formulation: Updates K-member rating ensemble X in R^{K x d} in ensemble subspace via symmetric eigendecomposition T = U (I + S)^{-1/2} U^T of C = A^T R^{-1} A and MacKay logistic-probit moment matching P(win) = sigma(d / sqrt(1 + pi*v/8)).
gse_ml_service_5_models.hardware_tier: Tier A (Local Exact Symmetric Eigendecomposition CPU)
